about: Live job-board rows (job-board list, x-rb-budget: probe, read-only) whose location carries a country's name, for postingCountryMismatch (SEO-035). Read: one list call per name in countryNameTable (298), then the US and five other large countries for every name with more rows, then offset pages for the names whose US rows ran past 60: 671 calls, 15,704 distinct rows. Kept here: every location string the rule at d1d5aa12 or this fix withholds, every string that names another country in a segment and is withheld by neither, and every input of the recheck that found the misreads. One case per distinct location and country; rows is how many corpus rows carried it.

labels.correct: the row's country is the country of the place, or of one of the places listed
labels.mismatch: the place is in another country than the row's
labels.unclear: the string alone cannot say which country is right

fields.before: what postingCountryMismatch at d1d5aa12 answered (true withholds the markup)
fields.src: corpus: read from the live board; recheck: an input of the 2026-10-25 rechecks
